system.description:
Use this skill just after you have successfully made a [Dodge Check] against an attack from the target. 

(Target: Mob): After the current Main Process ends, the target becomes [Incapacitated] or [Dead] (your choice).

(Hate Top): Deal 5 direct damage to the target.

A special skill that allows you to counterattack while avoiding attacks. A high-speed kick that leaves no trace, instantly incapacitating unimaginable enemies.
